bienvenida.eslogan: Get and manage your insurance in minutes, with full transparency.

registro.terminos: I accept the terms of service and authorize the processing of my personal data.
registro.terminosTexto: We collect your name, ID, contact details and address to create your account and offer you insurance. We use your data to verify your identity, generate quotes and issue your policies. We don't share it with third parties unless required by law. You can ask us to correct or delete it at any time.
registro.debeAceptar: You must accept the terms to create your account.
registro.confirmarSalida: If you leave now, you'll lose your data.

firma.introduccion: The electronic signature makes your insurance contract official. Read the policy terms before signing.
firma.clausulas:
1. Purpose. Solventa insures the risks described in the coverage of this policy during its term, in exchange for payment of the premium.
2. Premium. The premium is paid every month. If payments stop, coverage may be suspended, and we will let you know before that happens.
3. Your duties. You must give us truthful information when you buy and tell us if the conditions you declared change.
4. Claims. If a covered event happens, report it as soon as possible. We will review your case and get back to you with the outcome.
5. Termination. You can cancel the policy whenever you want. Solventa can only cancel it in the cases the law allows.
